info.title: Compass Search
info.description:
Self-hosted e-commerce search, merchandising and product discovery.

Authentication is a single `x-compass-key` header. Keys carry one of four ordered roles — search, analyst, merchandiser, admin — and each endpoint names the least role that may call it in `x-required-role`. A `ck_search_…` key is designed to ship inside a storefront bundle; every other role must stay server-side.

This document is generated from the running server's route table and validation schemas, so it cannot describe an API the server does not have.
